entities.name: Arabidopsis IQD7 Q2NND9
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana IQD7; 371 aa, predicted mass 41.15 kDa, pI 10.51.
Two Pfam IQ motifs identified at residues 95–114 and 117–134; reference annotation reports binding multiple calmodulins in the presence of Ca2+.
Proposed functions include recruiting calmodulin to microtubules and possible nucleic-acid association; listed localization includes nucleus, nuclear envelope, cytoplasm, and cytoskeleton.
